value.rationale: A natural first higher-dimensional nonabelian Heisenberg Lie algebra exhibits a genuine split between Lagrangian and symplectic plane fibers. The closed exact five-stratum degree distribution is a complete structural graph invariant for every finite field, not an arbitrary finite check. It explains precisely how symplectic incidence affects generation of subalgebras.
